mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_outbox_event ( event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, replay_count ) VALUES ( #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, #{payload}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{nextRetryTime}, #{replayCount} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, replay_count, last_replay_by, last_replay_time, create_time, update_time, sent_time FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE event_id = #{eventId}

SELECT id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, payload, status, retry_count, next_retry_time, locked_by, locked_until, last_error, replay_count, last_replay_by, last_replay_time, create_time, update_time, sent_time FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE ( status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_time <= #{now} ) OR ( status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until IS NOT NULL AND locked_until <= #{now} ) ORDER BY create_time ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit} FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_outbox_event SET status = 'SENT', sent_time = #{sentTime}, last_error = NULL, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_time = #{nextRetryTime}, last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_outbox_event SET status = 'DEAD', last_error = #{lastError}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_by = #{lockedBy}

UPDATE tb_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_by = #{adminId}, last_replay_time = #{now}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status = 'DEAD'

UPDATE tb_outbox_event SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = 0, next_retry_time = #{now}, locked_by = NULL, locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, replay_count = replay_count + 1, last_replay_by = #{adminId}, last_replay_time = #{now}, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE event_id = #{eventId} AND status IN ('SENT', 'DEAD')
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM tb_outbox_event GROUP BY status
SELECT AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, create_time, sent_time)) / 1000 FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE status = 'SENT' AND sent_time IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE( GREATEST(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, MIN(create_time), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)), 0), 0 ) FROM tb_outbox_event WHERE status IN ('PENDING', 'PROCESSING')
SELECT retry_count AS retryCount, COUNT(*) AS eventCount FROM tb_outbox_event GROUP BY retry_count ORDER BY retry_count ASC
mapper.delete: DELETE outbox FROM tb_outbox_event outbox WHERE outbox.status = 'SENT' AND outbox.sent_time < #{before} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM tb_inbox_event inbox WHERE inbox.event_id = outbox.event_id AND inbox.status IN ('PROCESSING', 'RETRYING', 'DEAD') )
